title: Applications II: new observables and a new dimension in SU(2) - the 1x2 Wilson loop, the electric energy band and the two-plaquette graph with independent couplings, and the 2+1D AM2 constants
selected_after_note: drafted and frozen during BC production because no BD2 item depends on a BC outcome; its gate is recorded after the BD1 gate
selection_reason: The admitted SU(2) equations (the AW1 centre grading and flip lemma, the AV1/AY1/AY2 state bounds, the AZ2 exact graph algebra, the BB2 limit of the named constructions and the AM2 majorant) apply to observables and dimensions the earlier rounds did not treat. BD2 applies them to the 1x2 Wilson loop, to the electric energy on the cover, to the two-plaquette graph with independent couplings, and to the 2+1-dimensional re-instantiation of the AM2 constants, and records the obstructions (a certified sign for the 1x2 loop, an area law, the unbounded Casimir) where the admitted machinery stops.
model: (a) the finite-graph model H_FG(l1,l2) = K - l1 W_1 - l2 W_2 on the Round11 two-plaquette graph (open two-square patch, 6 vertices, 7 links, gauge-invariant sector; K the sum of the seven link Casimirs at rho=1; alpha units; trace-monomial cutoffs D in {6,8}), with the observables W_1, the 1x2 loop z (the boundary of both squares) and the shared-link Casimir C_shared; (b) the SU(2) zero-selected patterned family (AM2/AQ1, |tau|<=10^-8) with the 1x2 Wilson loop W_{1x2} on two adjacent faces of the original loop's plane and the electric energy h_R on the cover R={0,e_z}, in every open centered box of F1 and F2 and for the limit of the named constructions (BB2); (c) the AM2 creation expansion re-instantiated in 2+1 dimensions for a declared 2D factorization.

parameters.metric: trace norm on B(H_R) for states; energy expectations through the on-site cutoff by monotone limits
parameters.weights: not applicable (no decay estimate); the AM2 radius and G-function of the 2+1D re-instantiation are derived in the packet
parameters.window: not applicable (static expectations and perturbative coefficients)

hamiltonian_terms.term: K: sum of the seven link Casimirs of the Round11 two-square patch (rho=1)

parameters.graph_orders: exact Rayleigh-Schroedinger coefficients of <W_1>, <z> and <C_shared> in (l1,l2) through total order 4 at D=6 and D=8
parameters.z3_1x2: first-order coefficient (exactly 0 by the centre grading), evenness in tau (AW1 flip, area 2; pointwise for the limit through BB2), and the formal second-order coefficient under the I1.5 convention with both faces at -(tau/3) W_f in delta units (labelled formal)
parameters.electric_band: for every finite box of F1 and F2 (untruncated at fixed N) and the limit of the named constructions, at both signs: a lower bound from h_R >= 6 Q_R (zero-selected on-site gap), Q_R = I - P_R, the Fuchs-van de Graaf inequality for the pure reference P_R and the AY2 two-sided first-order distance of rho_R from P_R; an upper bound from the admitted energy budget of the AQ1 reset; exact rational endpoints at tau=10^-8
parameters.dimension_2p1: declared 2D factorization with single-site factors owning the links (p,x) and (p,y), owner sets {p, p+e_x, p+e_y}, three faces per site, maximal support p=3; derive the AM2 G-function, radius, termination order and the per-site sum, and the admissible coupling cap, as exact rationals with directed enclosures of exponentials; the window kernel constants of AV2 (a one-dimensional spectral identity) recorded as dimension-independent

required: 1. Two-plaquette graph with independent couplings: compute the exact Rayleigh-Schroedinger coefficients of <W_1>, <z> and <C_shared> in (l1,l2) through total order 4 at D=6 and D=8 with zero truncation error; prove <W_1> odd in l1 and even in l2 by the one-link centre flip and check it on the coefficient table (hence every even-order coefficient of <W_1> at l1=l2 vanishes); record the second-order coefficients of <z> and <C_shared> at l1=l2.

2. Certified enclosures of <z> at l1=l2 on the AZ2 grid at D=6 and D=8 with the AZ2-type itemized residual, each excluding 0, the D=8 enclosure inside the D=6 one, with relative width at most the frozen value; the sign of <z> certified at every grid point.

3. Z^3 1x2 Wilson loop in the zero-selected family: prove the first-order coefficient is exactly 0 (centre grading), prove evenness in tau in every open centered box at kappa=0 and for the limit of the named constructions (AW1 flip lemma, area 2, and BB2 at each sign), and derive the formal second-order coefficient under the stated convention (labelled formal_second_order_coefficient; the sign and a remainder are recorded obstructions).

4. Electric energy band on R: prove the two-sided band for omega(h_R) at both signs for every finite box of F1 and F2 and for the limit of the named constructions, with exact rational endpoints at tau=10^-8 and the unbounded-observable passage through the cutoff made explicit; record the formal second-order value per link as labelled formal and the obstruction to a tight enclosure.

5. 2+1 dimensions: for the declared 2D factorization, derive exactly the owner sets, stars, faces per site, the per-site sum, the maximal support, the AM2 G-function and its derivative at the declared radius with directed enclosures, the termination order, and the resulting admissible coupling cap; record which Round32/Round33 statements transfer verbatim (algebraic ones) and which need their own contract (the AQ chain, the node, the dictionary, where g^2 has mass dimension).

6. Obligations and no-transfer rows: the area law (no zero-free region), a certified sign of the Z^3 1x2 loop (a uniform fourth-order remainder), a tight electric-energy enclosure, the site-blocked uniform 3+1D regime (its own contract), and the Einstein-QED rounds (no shared equation).
7. Quote the mandatory sentence template once as one unbroken span; export the gate fields; every control executed as a damaging mutation; exact checker byte-identical under -B and -B -O.
claim_exclusions: a certified value or sign of the Z^3 1x2 Wilson mean
an area law or string tension
a tight enclosure of the electric energy
an AQ chain, node or dictionary in 2+1 dimensions
any estimate uniform in the lattice spacing a
direction_note: Single direction: one forward producer computes the graph algebra (re-instantiating the admitted AZ2 exact solver), the Z^3 statements from admitted gates and the 2+1D constants; the skeptic replays from the contract alone with its own code before reading the producer.

acceptance.accepted_within_scope: Items 1-5 are proved or computed exactly as stated, the enclosures of item 2 meet the frozen width and exclude 0 at every grid point, the band of item 4 has exact endpoints at both signs for every box and the limit, and item 6 lists every obligation with its missing premise.
acceptance.limited: A graph order or cutoff is missing, an enclosure misses the width target, the band holds only for finite boxes, or the 2+1D constants are incomplete; each recorded with its reason.
acceptance.insufficient: The graph algebra or the band cannot be established; the admitted record is unchanged.

control_semantics_note: Inherited control ids are defined in the frozen contracts research/round33/contracts/ba1.json and bb2.json (declared premises); this contract's new_control_semantics override them.

new_control_semantics.graph_couplings_named: The two-plaquette graph model is H_FG(l1,l2) = K - l1 W_1 - l2 W_2 in alpha units with K the sum of the seven link Casimirs (rho=1) as in AZ2, every term named with its coefficient (rule R3), free reference computed in the same code path, model_is_finite_graph:true, transfers_to_aq:false; a value from another graph or coupling is rejected.
new_control_semantics.exact_rs_zero_truncation: Every graph coefficient is exact Rayleigh-Schroedinger algebra in the trace-monomial basis at both cutoffs D in {6,8} with zero truncation error shown (as AZ2), never fitted; a coefficient that differs between the cutoffs, or a fitted value, is rejected.
new_control_semantics.independent_coupling_flip: Oddness of <W_1> in l1 and evenness in l2 is proved by the one-link centre flip on a non-shared link of face 1 and checked on the exact coefficient table; a check at l1=l2 only is rejected as a proof of the two-variable statement.
new_control_semantics.enclosure_itemized_residual: Every certified graph enclosure carries the AZ2-type complete residual (per-link rows, joint channel, gauge projection, Ritz/Davis-Kahan/Eckart part, directed arithmetic) at every grid point; an enclosure without the itemized residual is rejected.
new_control_semantics.formal_coefficient_labelled: The Z^3 second-order coefficient of omega(W_{1x2}) is labelled formal_second_order_coefficient: no certified remainder, no sign and no numerical value of omega(W_{1x2}) at the cap is claimed; presenting it as a certified value or as a sign is rejected.
new_control_semantics.evenness_from_flip: Evenness of omega(W_{1x2}) in tau is the AW1 flip lemma (area 2) in every open centered box at kappa=0 and, through BB2 at each sign, for the limit of the named constructions; it gives no remainder bound.
new_control_semantics.unbounded_observable_handled: The electric energy h_R is unbounded: the upper bound uses the admitted energy budget and lower semicontinuity through the cutoff, the lower bound uses the bounded projection Q_R, trace duality and the admitted AY2 first-order distance; applying a bounded-observable trace-norm constant directly to h_R is rejected.
new_control_semantics.band_both_signs: The electric-energy band is stated at both signs of tau (even quantity) for every finite box of both families and the limit of the named constructions, with exact rational endpoints; the -tau statement is a mirror replay.
new_control_semantics.dimension_recount: Every 2+1D constant is recounted for the declared 2D factorization (owner sets, stars, per-site sum, maximal support p, termination order, G_p) and derived from the AM2 formula structure; a 3+1D constant reused in 2+1D is rejected; the 2+1D dictionary is not the 3+1D one.
new_control_semantics.no_area_law_claim: No area-law bound or string-tension statement is made (it would need analyticity of the reduced density, for which no zero-free region is admitted); it is recorded as an obligation.
new_control_semantics.no_transfer_to_eqed: The Einstein-QED evidence rounds share no equation with this chain; this is recorded as a no-transfer row, not as a comparison.
new_control_semantics.rate_range_stated: Every rate claim carries its range of N in the same clause; BD2 makes no new rate claim.
